title: Athletic Program
author: Josiah M.
desc:
Start every morning stretching in a water/electrolytes fast drink your gallon water/electrolytes do cardio then rest eat something start your workout

It’s really a boxing focused strength and athletic training program designed to build a stronger, faster, more explosive, and better conditioned athlete without taking away from boxing skill development

The program uses separate Push, Pull, Legs/Core, Athletic Full-Body, Boxing/Conditioning, and Mobility sessions

Training includes dips, weighted push ups, overhead pressing, pull ups, chin ups, rows, squats, Romanian deadlifts, Bulgarian split squats, lunges, kettlebell swings, kettlebell snatches, jumps, burpees, core training, heavy bag rounds, jump rope, running, swimming, and mobility work

The program is designed to support boxing rather than train purely for muscle size strength exercises develop the body, explosive exercises improve athletic power, and conditioning prepares the athlete to continue moving and performing while fatigued
